Official model: TensorFlow DeepLab ADE20K quantized 1 byte, version 1 (Apache 2.0).
https://www.kaggle.com/models/tensorflow/deeplab
https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models/tree/master/deeplab

Modified by Imasora development, 2026-10-31:
Model input/padding, decoder resize, context resize and global average pooling geometry changed from 513 to 193. Learned weight shard bytes are unmodified. Classification remains an experimental candidate, never verified recognition.
No evaluation photos are included in this directory.

2026-10-31: model-129.json adds a 129 geometry experiment with matching decoder/context/global pooling sizes. The original 193 model.json is retained for comparison. Learned weight shard bytes remain identical.
